BLAST is a global esports media network on a mission to create world-class entertainment experiences for millions of fans around the world. From high-energy arena shows and studio broadcasts to digital content that sets new standards, we bring the biggest moments in esports to life - working with top-tier partners like Valve, Riot Games, Epic Games, Ubisoft, Krafton, and more.

We move fast, think big, and aim high. Our environment blends deep industry experience with bold, tech-driven ideas - whether we’re perfecting a broadcast or chasing the next moonshot. BLAST has grown into a leading force in the esports space, but we’re just getting started when it comes to pushing boundaries and shaping the future of the industry.

You’ll be part of a diverse and dynamic organisation with roots in traditional sports, entertainment, and esports - all working together to deliver unforgettable experiences and keep raising the bar.

The team

You’ll be joining a high-performing team of industry experts who thrive on delivering results and pushing boundaries. We work hands-on with top-tier broadcast technology and cutting-edge products that power some of the most recognisable names in the industry.

Our culture is built around getting things done - we value initiative, ownership, and practical solutions over endless processes. At the same time, we believe in growing together: there’s plenty of room to learn, challenge yourself, and expand your skillset alongside experienced professionals.

Bonus? This job will take you places - literally. From major cities to remote broadcast sites, we travel the world to make things happen. If you're ready to bring energy, adaptability, and a sense of adventure, you'll fit right in.

Requirements

• Curious, quick learner and eager to master new technologies.

• Proactive and decisive with a strong sense of ownership

• Ability to work at our Copenhagen office and Brøndby Studio

• Ability to travel to and work at events globally

• Previous experience in working large broadcast shows on flightpack / OB Truck

• Proficient in the english language.

• Experience with broadcast switchers equipment, such as Sony / Grass Valley etc.

Responsibilities

• Programming and setting up Grass Valley K-Frame, Sony XVS and Blackmagic ATEM switchers for highly complex shows

• Implementing new technologies, allowing greater automation, through both Companion and Cerebrum

• Set up general broadcast equipment, including EVS, Cuepilot, Cameras, Riedel Intercom, Routers etc.

• Train directors and engineers on our various switchers, and keep us up to date on the latest technologies.

Benefits

• Competitive salary package

• Enhanced parental leave

• Pension and Health Insurance

• Awesome new office in the centre of Copenhagen and 2400m2 studio facility in Brøndby

• Team building and social events

• Lunch, snacks and sodas

• Company trips (2024 we all went to Barcelona and had a BLAST)

Working at

BLAST

We are BLAST – the global esports media network delivering world class entertainment experiences. Whether it be intimate broadcast studio shows, arena events, digital platforms or top-class multi-platform content, we create the most exciting, exhilarating and euphoric moments in esports. This includes BLAST Premier; a worldwide Counter-Strike: Global Offensive tournament where the best teams and brightest stars fight it out for a $4.25m total prize pool. Broadcast around the world in 100 territories to over 150m households. With BLAST we want to amplify the best elements of esports – excitement, competition and community. Creating exhilarating events, unmissable content and fan first experiences.

Building AI keeps getting cheaper and faster. Deciding what's worth building, and getting an organisation to actually commit to it, does not.

At Heyra, we build AI systems, workflows and data platforms that are meant to live in production from day one. We work closely with companies that are moving quickly and need a partner who can hold both the strategic picture and the delivery reality in one head.

We're looking for a Deployment Strategist: the person the client's leadership talks to. You own the relationship and the outcome. You sit with a C-suite buyer, understand where their business is actually trying to go, and translate that into a sharp, sequenced plan for what we build and why. Then you steer a strong engineering team to make it real - without being the one in the codebase.

This is the strategic counterpart to our engineers. Where they go deep into the build, you hold the commercial and strategic frame: what problem are we really solving, what impact are we creating, in what order, and how do we get the organisation to adopt it. You're more product manager than a traditional consultant, with a strong strategic angle - closer to an Engagement Manager who's technical enough to make the right calls than a slide-deck advisor.

You'll work closely with engineers, data specialists, strategists and designers in a company where ideas move quickly and the distance from thinking to building is intentionally small.

What you'll work on

• 
Owning client relationships at the leadership level - being the person the C-suite trusts

• 
Framing the real problem behind the ask, and shaping it into an engagement worth running together with our FDEs

• 
Sequencing what gets built, in what order, and being accountable for the business value - not just the artifact

• 
Steering engineering teams toward outcomes, translating in both directions between the client and the builders

• 
Driving adoption: managing expectations, working with the people who have to live with the solution, and staying through the part after launch

• 
Scoping, structuring and de-risking engagements as they evolve

• 
Spotting where the next opportunity sits inside an account and growing it

Requirements

You probably have experience with

• 
Management consulting, change management, adoption, implementation of AI-native solutions.

• 
Owning client or stakeholder relationships end to end, with real accountability for outcomes

• 
Product, programme or engagement leadership in a technical environment

• 
Being technically literate - fluent enough in data and AI to make the right calls and earn trust with both buyers and builders, without needing to write the production code yourself

• 
Translating between business strategy and what's actually buildable

• 
Bringing structure to ambiguous, fast-moving situations

• 
The patience to sit with a worried manager, and the stubbornness to stay until adoption actually lands

Curiosity, taste and the way you think matter just as much to us as specific tools or years of experience. We hire for the who, not the what - experience is an indicator of perspective, not a deciding factor for how senior a role you'll play here. We're hiring across levels and shape the role around the person.

Why Heyra

At Heyra, we believe consulting needs to be rewritten. We're building a consultancy designed for the agentic era. We design, build, and operate AI products that change how enterprises work - from problem to prototype to production.

We care deeply about craft, speed and building things that work in the real world.

Heyra brings together people from engineering, strategy, product, startup and creative environments. We keep teams small, collaboration close and momentum high.

You'll join a team where:

• 
people care deeply about what they build

• 
good ideas move quickly

• 
new technology gets explored early

• 
and where there is room to shape both the company and the way we work

We're around 50 people today after merging with Pyne, and we're only just getting started.

If owning how AI engagements get framed, sold and landed at Heyra sounds like your kind of work, send us a short note about yourself together with your CV. We care much more about curiosity, energy and the way you think than polished applications.

Benefits

• 
Healthcare insurance

• 
Pension plan

• 
Parental leave

• 
Social gatherings

• 
New tech gear

• 
Central office

• 
Free lunch, coffee, snacks, and Friday beers

• 
Skill development

• 
Paid holiday

• 
Remote work allowed

• 
Pet friendly

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in our expansion across Europe, designing, implementing, and maintaining the cloud infrastructure that powers our growth. You'll work closely with our development teams to streamline deployment processes, elevate our CI/CD pipelines, and ensure our systems remain secure, reliable, and scalable as we expand into new markets. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to shape infrastructure decisions at a company scaling fast across multiple regions.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Design, implement, and manage scalable infrastructure on AWS

• 
Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions to automate build, test, and deployment processes

• 
Collaborate with development teams to integrate DevOps practices throughout the software development lifecycle

• 
Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform to automate infrastructure provisioning and management

• 
Monitor system performance and health using New Relic, ensuring high availability and reliability

• 
Implement security best practices and ensure compliance with industry standards (including PCI DSS where applicable)

• 
Design and support infrastructure across multiple regions, with an eye toward resilience, redundancy, and data residency requirements

• 
Participate in a rolling on-call rotation, providing 24/7 support and ensuring critical issues are resolved quickly and efficiently

• 
Mentor junior team members and champion DevOps best practices across the team

Your skills & experience

What we are looking for:

• 
3+ years of experience as a Senior DevOps Engineer or equivalent

• 
Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform on AWS

• 
Strong background in AWS, including ECS, RDS, VPC, and ideally IoT Core

• 
Proficiency with CI/CD tools, specifically GitHub

• 
Experience with monitoring/observability tools such as New Relic

• 
Hands-on experience with Docker and containerized environments

• 
Solid understanding of networking, security, and system architecture

• 
Excellent problem-solving skills and strong attention to detail

• 
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across team

Ready to apply?

Ready to take your career to the next level? If you're passionate about DevOps and want to help build resilient, secure infrastructure at European scale, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and help shape Flatpay's next chapter of growth.

WHAT IS FLATPAY? At Flatpay, we believe that merchants deserve a payment solution that is easy to understand, affordable, and free from hidden fees. That's why we offer a straightforward pricing model with no setup fees for terminals, no subscription fees, and a flat rate for all card types. It's a breath of fresh air compared to the complicated and confusing pricing structures of our competitors.  What sets Flatpay apart is our dedication. We continuously strive to stay ahead of the curve, adapting our solutions to meet our client's evolving needs. Ready to be part of something extraordinary? WHAT's THE CULTURE LIKE? Flatpay is a fast-moving, performance-driven environment where people are trusted to take ownership from day one. We value initiative, resilience, and a strong work ethic. Our teams are collaborative and supportive, but we also set clear expectations and hold ourselves accountable to results.  As a growing business, things move quickly. That means you’ll have the opportunity to take on real responsibility early, contribute ideas, and see the impact of your work directly. It also means being comfortable with change, solving problems as they arise, and continuously improving how we operate.  We’re best suited to people who are motivated by challenge, enjoy working towards clear goals, and want to develop in a commercial, high-energy environment. WHY CHOOSE FLATPAY? Flatpay offers the opportunity to take real ownership, develop valuable skills, and grow your career in a fast-moving, ambitious company where performance and initiative are recognised.

About Flatpay

Flatpay is not just another payment solution; we're dedicated to innovating the market for payment solutions and financial services in the SME segment with our customer-centric and transparent services.

We've grown into one of the fastest-growing fintech companies out of the Nordics and Denmark's fastest unicorn company. Today, we're more than 2,000 colleagues across Europe, building products that make a real difference for our customers.

We're ambitious, move fast, and like to challenge the status quo - but we also believe work should be fun. We celebrate wins, help each other out, and create an environment where people can do great work while genuinely enjoying the journey.

About the job

Flatpay has become one of Europe's fastest-growing payment companies by helping merchants accept card payments in-store.

Our Point of Sale system serves as the central engine of the business. It streamlines the merchant's entire workflow — from order taking, product and inventory management, to payment processing, reporting, and compliance.

Some of the core capabilities include:

• 
Product catalogue: Organizes how they manage their products, categories, modifiers and inventory

• 
Order management: Basket, pricing, discounts, payments and managing tables and long-running orders among groups of customers.

• 
Hardware integrations to barcode scanners, receipt and kitchen/bar printers and our different Mobile-, Premium- and Basic POS devices. No least manage synchronicity across multiple POS systems at shared locations in realtime.

• 
Our reporting suite ensures cash management, end-of-day reports, various sales, turnover, staff, tax and compliance reports that enables merchants to optimize their business and comply with local tax regulations.

As our merchants grow, so does the platform. Every new market introduces new payment methods, fiscal requirements and merchant needs. Every new feature increases the depth and complexity of the product. And with our customer base doubling approximately every six months, the demands on scalability, reliability and performance continue to grow.

This is a hands-on engineering role with significant ownership. You'll influence technical direction, contribute to architectural decisions and solve the engineering challenges that come with building one of Europe's fastest-growing commerce platforms.

What you'll do

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll contribute far beyond implementation. You'll help shape technical direction while remaining deeply involved in building products. You'll work closely with Product, Design and fellow engineers to build software that scales across all dimensions: more merchants, more markets, more capabilities and increasingly sophisticated workflows.

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Designing, building and evolving features across our Point of Sale platform platform.

• 
Lead feature and platform initiatives involving multiple engineers, driving delivery from discovery through production

• 
Build APIs, services, and integrations that enable stock, order lifecycle, sales reporting & compliance reporting towards governmental standards of our markets.

• 
Take ownership of features from design and implementation through deployment and maintenance

• 
Drive architectural decisions and long-term technical improvements

• 
Improve reliability, observability, performance, and security across the platform

• 
Mentor engineers through coaching, code reviews, and knowledge sharing

• 
Continuously improving our engineering practices, tooling and development experience

• 
Contribute to testing, operational excellence and contribute to a collaborative team culture

Who you are

We're looking for experienced engineers who enjoy solving difficult problems and helping others succeed.

You likely bring:

• 
7+ years of professional software engineering experience

• 
Strong experience designing and operating distributed systems

• 
Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects involving multiple engineers and influence architectural decisions

• 
Comfortable navigating ambiguity and helping shape new products and systems

• 
The ability to break down complex problems into pragmatic, maintainable solutions.

• 
Strong communication and collaboration skills

• 
Experience building scalable backend platforms and APIs

• 
Continuously improve CI/CD pipelines

• 
A collaborative mindset and a willingness to challenge ideas constructively

• 
Contribute to testing, operational excellence and contribute to a collaborative team culture

• 
Experience within payments, fintech, e-commerce, SaaS, or high-scale transaction systems is a plus

You'll be working with the following technologies; we don't expect experience with every technology listed; we're looking for engineers who can learn quickly and help us build great products.

• 
Java, Spring Boot, JUnit

• 
MySQL, Flyway, SQS

• 
REST APIs

• 
Domain Driven Design

• 
Docker, Terraform, AWS ECS

• 
Ports and adapters architecture

Why Flatpay

Joining Flatpay means stepping into a dynamic environment where innovation is encouraged, and teamwork is celebrated. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, contributing to our mission of empowering merchants to succeed.

With us, you’ll experience an ambitious drive to constantly push boundaries and redefine what's possible. While we don’t take ourselves too seriously, we take our responsibility towards our people very seriously. We welcome driven, low-ego individuals who live our values and want to grow with us.

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

The Opportunity

Veo's security surface is unusual. We train models on-premise on dedicated GPU infrastructure, run the product across AWS and GCP, and operate a fleet of tens of thousands of cameras deployed at clubs and venues worldwide. That is a scope most SaaS security engineers never touch: physical devices in the field, heavy on-prem compute, and multi-cloud production, all in one role.

We are forming a Security Enablement Team that makes it easier for every engineering and IT team at Veo to build, ship, and operate secure systems. As the most senior engineer on the team, you will own the technical direction of the platform security, identity, and network security slice, partnering with the teams that own these systems so security is built in from the start. As an enablement function, the team does not run these systems day to day. We build the paved roads, tooling, and patterns that let the owning teams operate securely by default.

You will join during a pivotal moment. We are standing the team up, defining what good looks like across platform security, identity, and network security, and rolling out the first paved roads for image scanning, SBOM generation, CVE response, CI/CD identity, and a unified internal network across our datacenters (GCP, AWS) and offices (Miami, Berlin, and Copenhagen). You'll have direct impact on how 100+ engineers write, review and ship secure systems.

What You Will Do

You will join a focused platform security team and operate as its most senior engineer. Everything below follows the same pattern. We design the paved road, prove it works, and hand it to the team that will own it. We share ownership, pair on complex work, and rotate responsibilities, and we expect this role to set the bar.

• Design and build the paved roads for image scanning, SBOM generation, and CVE response, running inside the pipelines teams already use, with findings routed to the owners who can fix them under tracked SLAs

• Lead the design, reviews, and tooling for a unified internal network and VPN across GCP, AWS, and our Miami, Berlin, and Copenhagen offices, while the team that owns the network keeps running it

• Work with the auth service maintainers on identity and access, including MFA rollouts, removal of shared accounts, and cleanup of long-lived tokens, so the patterns stay theirs to own

• Make workload identity the paved road for CI/CD, using OIDC between GitHub Actions and AWS or GCP, packaged so teams can migrate themselves

• Build audit logging as a shared capability that teams plug into rather than reinvent

• Turn GRC controls into technical implementations, with evidence pipelines that produce auditable output without manual follow-up

• Own the contracting cycle for external penetration tests and build the intake, classification, and tracking system that routes findings to named owners, while the owning teams remediate

• Hand each capability off cleanly, with a runbook, a named owner, and an escalation path, and run office hours where product and platform teams can get a security review or a paved-road question answered

• Mentor the rest of the team and raise the security bar across Builders

As the team matures, you will help shape our multi-environment network architecture, our identity and access patterns, and the long-term security posture of the product.

What You Could Bring

This is a deliberately merged platform security and identity role. You do not need to be world class at both. You likely have several years of production infrastructure and security experience behind you, and you are deep and credible in one of these areas and ready to grow into the other.

That depth tends to show up in several of the following:

• Platform security: you have run vulnerability scanning, CVE management, and image scanning at scale, and you know the operational reality of getting CVEs fixed, beyond standing up the tooling

• Identity and auth: you have worked hands-on inside an auth codebase, rolled out MFA on live systems, and managed token lifecycles in CI/CD with OIDC and workload identity

• Network security at scale: you have designed and run a unified internal network across multiple cloud providers and offices, with a VPN approach that holds up

• Platform-as-product mindset: you have built internal security tooling that other teams chose to adopt, with guard rails built into the tools developers already use and manual review as a last resort, and you gathered feedback and measured the impact

• Infrastructure as Code: strong experience with Terraform, Crossplane, or similar

Nice to have: GitOps tools such as Flux or ArgoCD, Cilium, Kubernetes security at scale, and experience building security into a GRC evidence pipeline.

How We Work

You'll join a Copenhagen-based Security Enablement Team of three engineers plus a manager. We operate as an enablement function: we build shared tooling and golden paths, and we step in for focused, high-leverage missions where no other team is positioned to deliver. We do not run a SOC and we do not carry a security pager.

You'll collaborate regularly with the Platform, Product, IT, Firmware, and GRC teams. We work pragmatically and iterate quickly. This role sets the technical direction for the team's quarterly missions. We document decisions, favor simple solutions where possible, and focus on tooling and platform patterns that help teams move faster with confidence.

If you read that list and matched on three or four items but not all of them, apply anyway. The "deep in one, ready to grow into the other" framing above is not a hedge, it is how we actually hire at this level. We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger

outcomes.

Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally)

We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to make meaningful contributions.

Working at

Veo is the world’s leading AI powered and affordable football camera solution. We want to enable all teams around the world recording their football matches without the obstacles of finding a cameraman. Democratizing football, by giving access to video analysis, that in the past only were available for the few. The innovative dual-lense camera technology records the entire pitch at all times, with two 4K high resolution sports action lenses. Our intelligent software automatically follows the ball to create a broadcast view, while allowing you the controls with a simple click of you mouse. Our solution is developing better athletes. We know players are visual learners, seeing themselves play rather than being told of their mistakes is more effective and likely to produce results.

Flatpay is looking for an experienced Product Manager to join our Financial Services team. In this role, you'll help develop our customer-facing banking product, including the app that supports small and medium-sized businesses in their day-to-day financial activities. Hands-on product management experience with customer-facing apps is essential for this role.

You will work closely with engineers, designers, operations, commercial teams, and external partners to turn customer needs, business priorities, and technical requirements into clear product improvements. The role suits someone with product experience from a banking environment who can combine customer understanding, app expertise, and technical fluency.

What you will work on

• 
Develop and continuously improve Flatpay’s banking product and customer-facing app for SMEs.

• 
Turn customer feedback, product and user data, and business needs into well-defined product improvements.

• 
Work closely with other product managers, designers, and engineers throughout product discovery, definition, delivery, launch, and iteration.

• 
Translate customer, business, operational, technical, and relevant regulatory requirements into clear product priorities.

• 
Coordinate with commercial teams, operations, legal, and external partners.

• 
Track product performance and customer behavior to identify opportunities and resolve pain points.

• 
Contribute to product planning, prioritization, and post-launch improvements.

• 
Travel occasionally across Flatpay’s markets to collaborate with local teams, partners, and other stakeholders.

Who you are

You're proactive, structured, and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment. You take a hands-on approach and are willing to step into the details when needed. You can work independently, take ownership of your responsibilities, and move initiatives forward while keeping relevant colleagues informed and aligned.

You enjoy working closely with engineers, designers, and commercial teams, and you can turn complex requirements into practical product improvements. You combine customer focus with clear communication across different functions, and use evidence to make informed decisions.

What we are looking for

• 
5+ years of experience as a Product Manager, Product Owner, or in a similar role.

• 
Demonstrated product management experience launching, improving, and scaling customer-facing apps.

• 
Strong technical fluency and the ability to work effectively with engineers on APIs, data flows, integrations, and technical trade-offs related to app development.

• 
Previous product experience from a banking environment.

• 
Strong collaboration skills and experience working with engineers and cross-functional stakeholders.

• 
Ability to balance customer needs with technical, operational, commercial, and relevant regulatory considerations.

• 
A structured and analytical approach, with confidence using product data and customer insight to guide decisions.

• 
Practical experience applying AI tools to product discovery, analysis, or delivery is an advantage.

• 
Willingness and ability to travel occasionally across Flatpay’s markets.

• 
Professional-level English proficiency.

Why Flatpay?

Making life easier for SMEs is at the core of Flatpay’s work. As we continue to grow, our financial services help small and medium-sized businesses manage their finances and run their businesses more effectively. You'll help shape a banking product that is an important part of that experience.

Flatpay has more than 2,500 employees across seven markets. We value work-life balance, creativity, and collaboration, and you will join a supportive product environment with room to take initiative, learn, and improve how we serve our customers. Our Herlev office also offers an in-office gym, a fully equipped gamer room, free slush ice, and other ways to enjoy life at the office.

Reporting to the Product Director, you'll contribute to a banking product that supports Flatpay’s continued growth in financial services. This position is based in our Herlev office.

If this sounds like the right next step for you, we would love to hear from you!

Help shape the future of medical dermatology by building trusted partnerships and delivering meaningful business results across Denmark.

Join us in creating a future legacy in medical dermatology

At LEO Pharma, we are global leaders in medical dermatology. We have 118 years' experience in bringing innovation to healthcare. And we are eager to do much more. Each year, close to 100 million people have a better day because of our medicines. In Dermatology Denmark, you will join a team focused on expanding access to dermatology solutions through strong customer partnerships and excellent execution.

In our Nordic Dermatology unit, we share a “challenge accepted” mindset and are guided by our winning behaviours of simplification, collaboration, and accountability, to achieve our goals.

Your Role

As Key Account Manager, you will drive sales of our dermatology portfolio within your assigned territory. You will identify business opportunities, build and maintain strong relationships with dermatologists, general practitioners and other healthcare stakeholders, and execute customer-centric sales initiatives in line with company strategy. The role reports to the Nordic Head of Sales and involves close collaboration across the Nordic organization.

• Achieve sales targets and deliver business results through targeted territory planning and execution.

• Build and maintain relationships with decision-makers, influencers and other key healthcare stakeholders, using multichannel planning and CRM tools such as Veeva for effective follow-up and documentation.

• Identify new key customers and changes in decision-making processes, developing compliant solutions that create value for customers and LEO Pharma.

• Collaborate with Marketing, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Finance, Compliance and other internal functions to support national and regional activities.

• Monitor sales performance, analyse data, manage the KAM budget with an ROI mindset, and report progress to management.

The role offers:

• The opportunity to make a visible contribution to the growth of LEO Pharma’s dermatology business in Denmark.

• A cross-functional and Nordic working environment with broad internal collaboration.

• Ownership of customer relationships, territory execution, compliance, reporting and budget responsibilities.

• The chance to act as an internal knowledge partner and contribute to LEO Pharma’s values, vision and ethical guidelines.

Territory: Jutland

Your qualifications

To succeed in this role, we imagine that you have the following qualifications:

• A relevant academic degree in life sciences, business or a comparable qualification through experience.

• Proven experience managing key accounts, preferably in healthcare or pharmaceuticals, with demonstrated results.

• Strong skills in sales, negotiation and relationship management, together with a solid understanding of market dynamics, customer behaviour and business development.

• Proficiency with CRM tools and Microsoft Office.

• Fluency in English and Danish, both written and spoken, plus a willingness to travel and a valid driving licence.

LEO Pharma is built on collaboration, innovation and curiosity. Is this you? Can you bring a strong customer orientation, business acumen and a results-driven approach? We are looking for someone who communicates effectively, works in a structured way, collaborates across functions, acts with integrity and trustworthiness, adapts to change and contributes as a team player.

Your new team

You will be part of the Nordic Dermatology unit and work closely with KAM colleagues across the Nordics, the Nordic Head of Sales, Market Access, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Sales Force Effectiveness/Business Intelligence, Compliance and Finance. ********The International Clinical Education & Strategy CVUS manager is responsible for defining and executing the clinical education and alignment strategy across regions in close collaboration with internal stakeholders and external partners. The role ensures strong clinical differentiation of the product portfolio through effective education programs, third‑party partnerships, and close alignment with Marketing on competitive positioning to maximize sales effectiveness and win rate. the clinical education manager reports to the CVUS GM International.

Le/La Responsable International(e) de la Formation Clinique et de la Stratégie CVUS est chargé(e) de définir et de déployer la stratégie internationale de formation clinique et d’alignement, en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes internes et les partenaires externes.

Ce rôle garantit une forte différenciation clinique du portefeuille produits grâce à des programmes de formation efficaces, des partenariats avec des tiers et un alignement étroit avec le Marketing sur le positionnement concurrentiel, afin de maximiser l’efficacité commerciale et le taux de concrétisation des ventes.

Le/La Responsable de la formation clinique reporte au Directeur Général CVUS International.

****Job Description

******Key Responsibilities

****Clinical Education & International Clinical Management

**

• Define and lead the international clinical education strategy across regions, ensuring consistency, quality, and alignment with business priorities.

• Develop, deploy, and continuously optimize clinical education programs addressing customer needs, care pathways, and evolving clinical practices.

• Coordinate and align regional clinical leaders to ensure consistent execution of clinical education initiatives at international level.

• Monitor clinical education outcomes and leverage insights to improve adoption, customer engagement, and clinical confidence.

**Third‑Party & Industry Partnerships

**

• Establish and manage strategic partnerships with third‑party organizations, including medical device companies, education providers, and clinical institutions.

**Clinical Alignment with Marketing & Competitive Strategy

• Act as the clinical partner to the Marketing Director and Marketing teams to ensure strong clinical alignment in go‑to‑market strategies.

• Lead clinical input into competitive analysis, translating market and competitor insights into clear clinical value propositions.

• Adapt and validate battle cards and competitive tools by integrating clinical arguments aligned to competitive products and customer decision drivers.

• Support the optimization of win rate by ensuring sales teams are equipped with clinically relevant, differentiated, and credible competitive messaging.

**Cross‑Functional Collaboration & Strategy Execution

**

• Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Product Management, and R&D to ensure clinical insights are integrated into product positioning, roadmap discussions, and launch strategies.

• Communicate and monitor the execution and alignment of clinical strategies across international regions and zones.

• Provide regular feedback to senior leadership on clinical priorities, competitive landscape, and education performance.

****Qualifications

• Senior profile with an experience in the medical industry

• Experience in ultrasound & Cardiology

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Excellent organizational skills

• Willingness and ability to travel 50% of time

• Valid motor vehicle license

• Experience with interfacing with both internal team members, external customers and industrial group

• Working level English

• Ability to develop and execute multiple priorities and approaches to meet objectives

• Direct customer relationship experience

• Proven ability to effectively communicate across a distributed workforce

**Responsabilités clés

****Formation clinique et management clinique international

**

• Définir et piloter la stratégie internationale de formation clinique à travers les régions, en garantissant la cohérence, la qualité et l’alignement avec les priorités business.

• Développer, déployer et optimiser en continu des programmes de formation clinique répondant aux besoins des clients, aux parcours de soins et à l’évolution des pratiques cliniques.

• Coordonner et aligner les responsables cliniques régionaux afin d’assurer une exécution cohérente des initiatives de formation clinique au niveau international.

• Suivre les résultats des actions de formation clinique et exploiter les retours pour améliorer l’adoption, l’engagement des clients et la confiance clinique.

**Partenariats tiers et partenariats industriels

**

• Établir et gérer des partenariats stratégiques avec des organisations tierces, notamment des fabricants de dispositifs médicaux, des organismes de formation et des institutions cliniques.

• Co‑développer des initiatives éducatives conjointes, des programmes cliniques et des contenus visant à renforcer la crédibilité clinique et l’impact marché.

• S’assurer que tous les partenariats respectent les exigences réglementaires, éthiques et les standards de l’entreprise, tout en générant une valeur mesurable.

**Alignement clinique avec le marketing et la stratégie concurrentielle

**

• Agir en tant que partenaire clinique du/de la Directeur(trice) Marketing et des équipes marketing afin d’assurer un fort alignement clinique des stratégies de mise sur le marché.

• Piloter l’apport clinique aux analyses concurrentielles et traduire les informations marché et concurrentielles en propositions de valeur clinique claires.

**Collaboration transverse et exécution de la stratégie

**

Intro

Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you’ll do well with us.

AI is built into how we work. It helps us ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean. Everyone at Monta is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully - and to find smart ways to use them to move the work forward.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people - sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You’ll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

We’re looking for a Jun/Mid Level Engineer who’s ready to roll up their sleeves, take ownership, and build with us - through the grind and the wins.

This Is What You Will Achieve

• 
Owned an OCPP hardening project - chased down a recurring class of vendor quirks (malformed messages, connection drops, the long tail of hardware oddities), shipped the fix, and measurably cut failed sessions or disconnections for that device family.

• 
Helped shift the team from reacting to incidents to preventing them, through alerting and observability work that catches problems earlier.

• 
Made real progress on OCPP 1.6, OCPP 2.0.1, and OCPI standards work that other services and front-ends across Monta now rely on.

What You Will Do

• 
Build and maintain backend services in NetOps' OCPP and charge point domain - protocol handling, message processing, device state, integrations with hardware vendors.

• 
Debug things that only break in the field. A charge point in Belgium disconnects every 40 minutes - you'll read the OCPP traffic, reproduce it against our emulator, find the cause, and fix it.

• 
Improve observability and alerting. Add the metrics, dashboards, and alerts that mean the next person doesn't have to guess.

• 
Take part in on-call once you're ramped up, with a team that treats a rough night as a reason to fix the system, not a rite of passage.

• 
Automate manual work away - a meaningful part of NetOps' job is removing the human steps that don't scale as our network grows.

• 
Collaborate across Product, Support, and the operations teams who live with the consequences of what we ship. You won't work in a silo.

A brief overview of our tech stack:

• 
Kotlin services (JVM), with Java where it already lives

• 
PHP/Laravel monolith - parts of our charge point domain still run here

• 
OCPP 1.6 / 2.0.1 and OCPI protocol handling

• 
Event-driven work with Kafka where message volume calls for it

• 
Observability via Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenSearch/Kibana

• 
AWS + Kubernetes, with Terraform for infrastructure

What We’re Looking For

• 
1–4 years of backend engineering experience, or a strong junior track record with real production exposure. You write clean, readable code and finish what you start.

• 
Comfortable in a JVM language - Kotlin preferred, Java fine, and we'll help you get there from another stack if the fundamentals are strong. Willingness to touch PHP in our legacy monolith when the work calls for it.

• 
You enjoy debugging, genuinely - logs, traces, packet-level detail, weird one-off reports from a single customer.

• 
A sense of ownership - you follow your work into production, watch it, and flag problems early rather than waiting to be asked.

• 
Nice to have: curiosity about the physical world (our systems talk to metal boxes with electricity in them); clear communication - you can explain what broke and why to someone who isn't an engineer; advanced, deliberate use of AI tools in your daily engineering workflow.

• 
Bonus points for: exposure to OCPP, OCPI, EV charging, or the EV industry as a driver or enthusiast; IoT, embedded, or telemetry systems where devices in the field misbehave; event-driven architectures (Kafka) or high-volume message processing; reliability/monitoring/on-call experience (Prometheus, Grafana, SLOs); Kubernetes, Terraform, or infrastructure-as-code exposure.

If the mission excites you but your experience isn’t a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway - we care about potential, not perfection.

AI Competency

• 
You’ll be expected to work with AI-powered tools. Some we use:

• 
GitHub Copilot / Claude Code

• 
ChatGPT / Gemini / Claude

• 
Notion AI (docs, knowledge, meeting notes)

• 
Analytics & ML: Langfuse, PyTorch, Mastra

• 
AI-enhanced testing & monitoring (e.g., generative QA, Grafana ML)

• 
We don’t expect mastery of all - but we expect comfort learning, experimenting, and adopting AI responsibly.

Why Monta

• 
Impact, not easy mode - your work matters, and you’ll feel it every day.

• 
Ownership from day one - we don’t micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• 
The grind is real - priorities shift, and flexibility is sometimes needed to get things across the finish line. But so are the rewards: impact, growth, and a team that has your back.

• 
The people are extraordinary - talented, driven, and fun to work with. You’ll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure.

What We Offer

• 
A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• 
A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• 
Free lunch every day.

• 
Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• 
Paid parental leave to support life's big moments.

• 
Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• 
Flexible working hours; as long as you're at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

Please send us your application in English.

To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you'll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won't agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

Monta is the operating platform powering the EV charging ecosystem serving drivers, companies, cities, and the electricity grid with one integrated software solution. We believe that accelerating and democratising the adoption of EV technology is key to building a better future. Monta’s mission is to provide the best technology solutions for the entire EV charging cycle. At our core, we provide access, innovation, and reliability to the mobility transformation. We're here to make the transition to electric mobility as seamless and exciting as possible. With a single integrated software built to EV better. Founded in 2020 our team has been growing fast and are now more than 200 employees with 47 different nationalities. Our HQ is based in Copenhagen, and we have offices in Oslo, Berlin, Paris, London and just opened Barcelona. Our culture is based on trust, transparency, and respect, where everyone contributes to making Monta what it is. You don't have to work 9-17, we trust our people to know how they work best. We empower each team to choose how and when they work. Inclusion is also a big part of our culture, and we make sure that everybody feels welcome, heard and able to bring all of who they are to work. We take it upon ourselves to protect this space that has allowed us to get this far. Monta is dedicated to encouraging a supportive, diverse and inclusive culture amongst all Monteers as they are fundamental to our values as a company. One of the best things about Monta is our people. Right from the get-go you will feel how inclusive, diverse, sociable and friendly our team is. We go to the office as much as possible, not because we have to, but because we enjoy each other's company - even outside work hours we hang out together. We have lots of different clubs you can join, there's a chess club, a ski club, (there's a slack channel for every little interest we can bond over). Everyone is very passionate about what we do and invested in the product and their role. We are a team of innovators, experts, and “bar-setters” in our fields. We believe that we can create the path needed to sustainably scale the industry towards the future. We're biased toward action, so we're always looking for ways to improve and make things work for many, not just few. We don't just want to be good at what we do—we want to be the best at it. Better results, better technology, better systems, better together. The combination of all this, and the feeling that we are contributing something great to the world, gives everyone a strong sense of belonging and makes our employees and customers want to work with us - it helps our company thrive. Everyone here is proud to be a 'Monteer'. If you’d like to work in a green, tech-driven company and are passionate about innovation, we might be the right fit! We've got an incredible team, and hope to find more peers who can help us push things even further.

**About The Job

**Join Saxo’s Enterprise Identity & Data Security (EIDS) team and help strengthen the bank’s privileged access management capabilities. You will be responsible for implementing, operating, and continuously improving PAM controls that protect privileged accounts, administrative access, and critical systems across Saxo’s technology landscape.

Working closely with infrastructure, cloud, security, and application teams, you will help reduce privileged access risk through modern PAM practices, automation, and Zero Trust principles.

**Responsibilities

**

• Implement and manage privileged access controls across on-premises and cloud environments

• Administer PAM capabilities including credential vaulting, password rotation, session management, and privileged session recording

• Onboard privileged accounts, systems, applications, and service accounts into the PAM platform

• Support adoption of least-privilege, Just-In-Time (JIT), and Zero Trust access models

• Automate PAM processes and integrations using PowerShell and APIs

• Support monitoring, reporting, audits, and access to governance activities

**Your profile

**You are an experienced cybersecurity professional with a strong background in Privileged Access Management (PAM), Identity & Access Management (IAM), and security engineering. You combine deep technical expertise with a practical, risk-based approach to securing critical systems and privileged access within complex enterprise environments.

• 7-10 years of experience in Privileged Access Management, Identity & Access Management, or Cyber Security Engineering

• Hands-on experience with enterprise PAM solutions

• Strong understanding of privileged access risks, account lifecycle management, and security best practices

• Experience securing Windows, Linux, cloud platforms, databases, and network devices

• Knowledge of Active Directory, Entra ID, and Azure environments

• Experience with automation and scripting, including PowerShell and APIs

• Experience working in regulated environments, preferably within financial services

Certifications & Platforms

You have practical experience working with leading PAM technologies and understand how privileged access controls support a broader security strategy. Experience with multiple platforms is highly valued, particularly in enterprise-scale environments.

• Experience with Delinea Secret Server or other Delinea PAM solutions will be considered a strong advantage

• Experience with CyberArk, BeyondTrust, One Identity, or similar PAM platforms is also highly valued

**Personal competencies

**You are a structured and proactive professional who thrives on solving complex security challenges. You can effectively collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders and translate business and security requirements into practical solutions.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities

• Structured, proactive, and delivery-focused mindset

• Ability to translate security requirements into practical technical solutions

• Strong collaboration skills and a continuous improvement mindset

**We get curious people invested in the world

**When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

jobs.description:
Ambu A/S is currently looking for a Global Process Owner, Order to Cash to be based in Denmark

In this role, you will own Ambu’s global end-to-end Order to Cash process within our ERP transformation, covering sales planning, order management, distribution, invoicing, customer service and collections. You will report to the Global Operations Program Director, with dual reporting to the Director, Supply Chain Transformation, and work closely with Global Business Owners, other Global Process Owners, Commercial, IT, Finance, Quality and site leadership.

This is a unique opportunity to create a globally aligned Order to Cash capability and set the standard for how it operates across Ambu. It will suit an experienced leader who combines strategic thinking with the ability to deliver transformation at scale.

**Key Responsibilities

**Your main responsibilities will include:

• Owning the global Order to Cash process vision, standards, governance and roadmap

• Acting as Business Workstream Lead and driving fit-to-standard design

• Leading process decisions that balance service, cash, compliance and customer experience

• Establishing process KPIs and driving readiness and adoption across countries

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are however likely to succeed in this position if you:

• Have 10+ years of experience in supply chain, operations or business transformation, from industry or consulting

• Have deep expertise across the complete Order to Cash value stream

• Are comfortable working across time zones and travelling across Ambu’s global footprint

• Have experience from a regulated environment, ideally medical devices, life sciences or pharmaceuticals

• Have led large-scale ERP-enabled transformations or Order to Cash workstreams

• Are structured, proactive and outcome-oriented, with strong stakeholder management skills

• Have SAP S/4HANA, Infor, Oracle Cloud or similar experience and strong written and spoken English

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.
